notes: Scene-grammar registry. Layout lives in lib/grammar.css, motion in lib/motion.js. Annotate each scene: <section class="clip g-scene" data-grammar="<id>" data-variant="<variant>" data-beat-kind="<kind>">. Choose grammars from beat content (suitable_for), never at random.

fade_scale.description: Opacity 0 to 1 with scale 0.96 to 1. Quiet default for media and stats.

rtl_slide.description: Enters from the right (+x), the Arabic reading start. Text blocks and columns.

mask_reveal.description: clip-path wipe revealing right to left. May start partly revealed so a hook is visible at frame 0.

stagger_build.description: Items appear one by one in DOM (reading) order.

line_draw.description: Rules, dividers and connectors draw from the right (or top for vertical rules).

hard_cut.description: No transition. The clip boundary is the cut.

push_in.description: Slow linear scale-up across the scene. Media only.

zoom_to_detail.description: Animated move from the full screenshot to one real region.

fade_out.description: Short opacity fade before the clip ends.

mask_out.description: clip-path wipe continuing right to left.

crop_to_region.description: Frame one region of a real screenshot (instant, no motion).

highlight_box.description: Outline one region; the box travels with any zoom.

callout_line.description: Draw a line/arrow from a label point to a region.

pan_regions.description: Move between two regions of the same screenshot.

full_bleed_media.name: Full-bleed media
full_bleed_media.layout: Media fills the frame edge to edge with a legibility scrim; the text band sits inside the text-safe zone.
full_bleed_media.media_treatment: Official photo or video, object-fit cover. Optional slow push_in. Never a screenshot with small text.
full_bleed_media.rtl: Text band anchored to the right edge; the headline mask reveals right to left.
full_bleed_media.use_cases: Hooks and scene-setting when strong official imagery exists.
full_bleed_media.avoid: Low-resolution media, dense screenshots, stories without an official visual (do not generate one).

split_media_text.name: Split media and text
split_media_text.layout: Two regions: text column and media. Landscape splits columns; portrait stacks media over text.
split_media_text.media_treatment: Official image, chart or product shot in a card; optional push_in or one highlight_box.
split_media_text.rtl: Text column on the right (reading start), media on the left; variant media_right swaps. In portrait media_left means media on top.
split_media_text.use_cases: Explaining a claim next to its official evidence.
split_media_text.avoid: Media that needs full width to be legible; more than two lines of secondary text.

big_number.name: Big number
big_number.layout: One verified figure dominates the frame with a short label and an optional rule.
big_number.rtl: The number is an LTR run (direction: ltr) inside an RTL label block; offset variant aligns to the right edge.
big_number.use_cases: A single sourced number that carries the story.
big_number.avoid: Unverified or estimated numbers; more than one number per scene.

kinetic_word.name: Kinetic words
kinetic_word.layout: A short phrase at display size; words build in reading order.
kinetic_word.rtl: Words build in reading order starting at the right. Never reorder words for animation.
kinetic_word.use_cases: Hooks without strong media, and takeaways.
kinetic_word.avoid: Phrases longer than about eight words.

screenshot_detail.name: Screenshot detail
screenshot_detail.layout: One real screenshot in a frame that keeps its native aspect ratio; the camera moves to the detail that matters.
screenshot_detail.media_treatment: Official screenshot only, never fabricated UI. Visual treatment only: zoom, crop, highlight, spotlight, callout, pan.
screenshot_detail.rtl: The screenshot keeps its own direction (direction: ltr inside the frame); headline and caption are RTL, right-aligned.
screenshot_detail.use_cases: Showing the exact official UI, chart or diagram region a claim refers to.
screenshot_detail.avoid: Screenshots containing fictional sample data; regions not supported by the source.

progressive_list.name: Progressive list
progressive_list.layout: Two to four rows that build one by one, optionally numbered, with a connecting rule.
progressive_list.media_treatment: None, or a small official logo per row.
progressive_list.rtl: Numbers and rows start on the right; rows build top to bottom in reading order.
progressive_list.use_cases: Steps, stages, or a short set of verified features.
progressive_list.avoid: More than four rows; rows longer than one line.

comparison.name: Comparison
comparison.layout: Two parallel columns (or stacked blocks) separated by a drawn divider.
comparison.media_treatment: None, or matching official logos/icons in both columns.
comparison.rtl: The right column is the reference (before / first); the left column is the change (after / second).
comparison.use_cases: Before and after, two roles, two products, with parallel wording.
comparison.avoid: Unbalanced or implied superiority claims that the source does not make.

quote_or_statement.name: Quote or statement
quote_or_statement.layout: One attributed statement at display size with an accent bar and visible attribution.
quote_or_statement.rtl: Accent bar on the right edge; the attribution (for example بحسب NVIDIA) is always visible.
quote_or_statement.use_cases: A company's own claim, clearly attributed, or the closing statement.
quote_or_statement.avoid: Invented quotations. Paraphrases must not use quotation marks.
